info.name: Virtual Office
info.summary: A small shared office for your Team or Talk conversation. See who's around and drop by before you start a call.
info.description:
Remote teams lose the small moments: seeing that someone is around, asking a quick question, having a coffee together. Virtual Office brings a little of that back, inside Nextcloud.
A Team, a group or a Talk conversation gets a small shared office. Everyone who belongs to it can see who is there and step in as a character. Walk over to a colleague, wave, make a coffee together, or knock to ask "got 2 minutes?" before you start a call.
**Right inside Talk**
Open a conversation's office from any message menu and use it right in the chat. The office shows when the conversation's call is running, and you can join the call from there.
**Small moments, without a meeting**
- Knock on someone; they answer Now, In 10 minutes or Later - Claim a desk that shows your status and a note for the day while you are out - Focus together in 25 or 50 minute sessions - Sign up for a weekly coffee roulette in group offices - See who is in your offices on the Dashboard, and find offices in search, the Smart Picker and on Team pages - Pick a rabbit, cat, bear or bird, then a color and an accessory - Use the map with a mouse, touch or the keyboard, or the people and places list with a screen reader
**Privacy**
Opening an office never makes you visible: you choose Enter office. Only members of the Team, group or conversation can enter. Virtual Office keeps no history of visits or movement.
**Requirements**
Nextcloud 35, with no extra server. Talk adds conversation offices and calls (tested with Talk 25). Teams adds Team offices, Deck shows due cards on Team boards, and Client Push makes movement instant. Group offices work without other apps.
See the office in motion at https://hweihwang.com/virtualoffice/
info.author: Hoang Pham
